item.title: ‘Unwanted record’: Ex-captain stunned after bizarre blunder by Pak at World Cup
item.summary: Pakistan's hockey captain received a green card after gear was forgotten. This incident occurred during their opening World Cup match against England. The team failed to produce necessary protective equipment for a penalty corner. Former captain Salman Akbar criticised the lack of preparation and organisation. This lapse raises serious questions about the team's readiness for major events.
